legal.subtitle: Connect, engage, and earn securely with Pesatone.

privacySections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Pesatone is committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share information when you use the platform.
By using Pesatone, you agree to this policy. Questions can be sent to support@pesatone.com.

privacySections.title: 2. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide when you create an account, make or receive payments, or contact us. This may include your name, email, phone number, profile image, and payment details.
We may also collect device and usage information such as IP address, browser, operating system, referring page, and visited pages.

privacySections.title: 3. How We Use Information
paragraphs: We use information only for legitimate platform and service purposes.
bullets: Respond to questions and service requests

privacySections.title: 4. Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent personal information. We may share the minimum necessary information with payment and hosting providers, other users when needed to complete a transaction, or authorities when legally required.

privacySections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect personal information. Report suspected unauthorized account use immediately to support@pesatone.com.

privacySections.title: 6. Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain information while your account is active and as needed to provide services, meet legal duties, resolve disputes, and prevent fraud. You may request account deletion.

privacySections.title: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, or portability of your personal data. Contact support@pesatone.com to make a request.

privacySections.title: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies for authentication, language preference, security, and essential platform operation. Disabling required cookies may prevent parts of Pesatone from working.

privacySections.title: 9. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Pesatone is not intended for people under 18. We do not knowingly collect children's personal information and will remove it when identified.

privacySections.title: 10. Policy Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy and will publish material changes on this page. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised policy.

privacySections.title: 11. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about this policy can be sent to support@pesatone.com.

termsSections.title: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By using Pesatone, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
You must be at least 18, or otherwise legally able to enter a binding agreement where you live.

termsSections.title: 2. Accounts
paragraphs: Provide accurate information, choose an appropriate username, and keep your password confidential. You are responsible for activity performed through your account.
Report unauthorized account use to support@pesatone.com.

termsSections.title: 3. Acceptable Use
paragraphs: Use Pesatone lawfully and respectfully. Do not harass others, post unlawful or harmful content, disrupt the service, or introduce malicious software.

termsSections.title: 4. Payments
paragraphs: Pesatone facilitates gifts between supporters and creators. Applicable fees are shown before a transaction is completed.
You are responsible for accurate payment details. Transactions are also subject to the terms of the relevant payment provider.

termsSections.title: 5. Creator Responsibilities
paragraphs: Creators are responsible for their content and must follow applicable law. Profiles and claims must be accurate.
Pesatone may deduct disclosed service fees from transactions.

termsSections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
paragraphs: Pesatone's platform, branding, and original functionality are protected by intellectual-property law.
Content you post remains yours, but you grant Pesatone the limited permission needed to operate and improve the service.

termsSections.title: 7. Privacy
paragraphs: Use of Pesatone is also governed by the Privacy Policy, which explains how personal information is handled.

termsSections.title: 8. Disclaimers and Liability
paragraphs: Pesatone is provided as available without a guarantee of uninterrupted or error-free service. Liability is limited to the extent permitted by applicable law.

termsSections.title: 9. Termination
paragraphs: We may suspend or terminate access when these terms are violated, users are harmed, or legal and security reasons require it.

termsSections.title: 10. Changes
paragraphs: We may update these terms and will publish material changes on this page. Continued use means you accept the revised terms.

termsSections.title: 11. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@pesatone.com.
